town_description: Sagar is a major city in central Madhya Pradesh, headquarters of Sagar district, known for Lakha Banjara Lake, the Dr. Hari Singh Gour University, and Eran's Gupta-era temples nearby. It lies on NH-26 between Bhopal and Jabalpur. Shri Dev Ram Bagh Mandir sits in the old commercial heart of the city near Bada Bazar and Sarafa Bazar.
